render_policy: Reference all named characters by ID; never overwrite identity fields from an episode script. Require approved visual refs and approved voice sample before rendering production.

characters.name: Ember
characters.visual: Small russet-orange red fox cub; white-tipped LEFT ear; large amber eyes; cream muzzle and chest; fluffy tail with ivory tip; teal scarf with ONE stitched gold star, always wrapped on neck; short rounded legs; no shoes or other clothing.
never_change: teal scarf with single gold embroidered star
same short rounded body and tail
characters.personality: hopeful, impulsive, brave; hides grief behind jokes
characters.arc: from blamed outsider to trusted protector

voice.voice_direction: light, curious, youthful, eager; quick before danger and softer when hurt; not shrill
voice.delivery: brisk curious lines, small pauses before confessions
voice.audition: I didn’t start the fire. But I can still save our home.

characters.name: Moss
characters.visual: Large elderly olive-green tortoise; weathered domed shell with a natural spiral growth pattern; pale moss-colored underbelly; kind half-lidded eyes; tiny crack on front right edge of shell; no glasses.
characters.personality: wise and patient, with guilt about an old warning
characters.arc: confesses he failed to repair the dam alarm

voice.voice_direction: deep, measured, elderly mentor; warm without becoming comical
voice.audition: Some truths take a lifetime to find, little fox.

characters.name: Luma
characters.visual: Petite barn owl with ivory heart-shaped facial disk, blue-gray wings with tiny pale silver speckles, golden irises, short feather tufts; no clothes or jewelry.
characters.personality: observant, analytical, secretly frightened of flying through storms
characters.arc: reveals the lost warning system and confronts her fear

voice.voice_direction: soft, perceptive, reassuring and precise; slightly airy
voice.delivery: quiet thoughtful pauses and restrained alarm
voice.audition: The storm arrived after the flames. Someone changed the signal.

characters.name: Ash
characters.visual: Lean slate-gray young wolf; charcoal fur on forelegs and back; pale blue eyes; narrow scar above RIGHT eyebrow; one small notch in right ear; no clothing.
characters.personality: guarded, proud, torn between family and conscience
characters.arc: admits family covered up failed dam warning; chooses honesty

voice.voice_direction: low, reserved, slightly rough; defensive first, sincere later
voice.delivery: short clipped sentences giving way to vulnerable pauses
voice.audition: I know what really happened. And you’re not going to like it.

voice.voice_direction: gentle but cinematic British female storyteller, calm suspense
voice.delivery: clear delivery; leave space for sounds
voice.audition: That night, a single blue feather changed the whole forest.
